sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Part 6 跨句指涉、However/Therefore/Meanwhile/Otherwise、Only after/Not until/No sooner 倒裝、要求式假設語氣、主詞動詞一致、Reduced relative clause
sections.markdown:
主題：**Part 6 跨句指涉、However/Therefore/Meanwhile/Otherwise、Only after/Not until/No sooner 倒裝、要求式假設語氣、主詞動詞一致、Reduced relative clause**

### 規則 1

This/These/Such/It/They 必須能找到明確先行詞

### 規則 2

Only after/Not until 置於句首時，主句使用助動詞倒裝

### 規則 3

No sooner/Hardly/Scarcely 置於句首時，常用 had + S + p.p.

### 規則 4

recommend/request/require/insist + that + S + 原形動詞

### 規則 5

A number of + plural verb；The number of + singular verb

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Vendor Renewal
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Man: Has the software renewal been approved? Woman: Finance approved the base package, but Legal is still reviewing the data-processing addendum. If they sign off by Thursday, we can renew at the quoted rate. Otherwise, the vendor says the discount expires Friday and we'll need a revised quotation. Man: So I shouldn't tell the team the price is locked in? Woman: Not yet. Please ask the vendor to hold the quote until Thursday if possible.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Conference Room Selection
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Woman: We need a room for thirty people on Tuesday from one to four. Wheelchair access is required, and the room must have a projector. Our total limit is four hundred fifty dollars. Man: Oak is large enough but not accessible. Cedar is inexpensive, but it isn't available until three. Pine is available at one, though the projector adds seventy dollars to the three-hundred-ninety-dollar room rate. Woman: That puts it over budget. Maple seems to meet everything. Please put a provisional hold on it.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Portal Deadline Update
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Attention, applicants. The grant portal was originally expected to reopen Wednesday at 9 A.M. Repairs are taking longer, and access is now expected at 11:30 A.M. You may review documents you previously downloaded, but no new applications can be submitted during the outage. Applications originally due Wednesday at noon will be accepted until Thursday at 10 A.M. Automatic reminders may still display the old deadline. The extended deadline remains valid.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Training Registration / Discount Threshold / Updated Deadline
sections.markdown:
限時：**8 分 30 秒**。

### Training Registration Policy

> Standard registration costs $240 per participant. Groups of 12 or more receive a 15% discount on the registration subtotal only. Optional printed materials cost $18 per participant and are not discounted. A $90 room setup fee applies once per group and is not discounted. Participant-count changes may be made without an administrative fee through November 12. Later changes normally incur a $40 fee.

用途：參考文件

### Booking Summary

> Harbor Consulting registered 12 participants for a November 20 training session and selected printed materials for all participants. On November 13, two participants withdrew, leaving 10 expected attendees. The team is considering either reducing the registration to 10 or keeping 12 registrations. The total budget is $2,800.

用途：參考文件

### Provider Update

> Because our registration portal was unavailable on November 12, Harbor Consulting may confirm a revised participant count through November 14 without the usual $40 administrative fee. The 15% group discount applies only when 12 or more registrations are purchased. Printed materials are billed according to the final number of registrations purchased. We will not change the booking automatically. Please confirm the final count by November 14.

用途：參考文件

sections.markdown:
限時：**2 分 30 秒**。

### 閱讀文章

> Subject: Revised Contract Review Process
> 
> Beginning next month, all vendor contracts above $50,000 must receive both Finance and Legal approval before signature.
> 
> [1] _____
> 
> This additional step is intended to reduce pricing and compliance risks.
> 
> Contracts already approved under the old process will remain valid. [2] _____, any amendment made after the new policy takes effect must follow the revised approval sequence.
> 
> Once both departments approve the final draft, it [3] _____ to the authorized signer.
> 
> [4] _____

sections.title: ⑩ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧 **Day 34、Day 35、Day 36、Day 37、Day 38**。

- 倒裝句
- 要求式假設語氣

- Calculation

- `IMP`：Implication
- `I`：Information Integration
- `U`：Updated Information

- `T`：Timeline
- `CAL`：Calculation
- `BUD`：Budget Constraint

questions.prompt: No sooner _____ the agreement been signed than the client requested an amendment.
questions.explanation: No sooner + had + subject + past participle.

questions.prompt: Only after Finance approved the budget _____ the team place the order.
questions.explanation: Only after at the beginning triggers inversion: did + subject + base verb.

questions.prompt: The director requested that the revised clause _____ reviewed again.
questions.explanation: request that + subject + base verb; passive form is be reviewed.

questions.prompt: The documents _____ by Legal yesterday are now final.
questions.explanation: The documents receive the action, so use the past participle reviewed.

questions.prompt: The vendor missed the deadline. _____, the client requested compensation.
questions.explanation: The request for compensation is a consequence of the missed deadline.

questions.prompt: The renewal cannot proceed _____ Legal approves the addendum.
questions.explanation: Unless expresses the required condition.

questions.prompt: Please retain the confirmation email _____ a billing dispute arises.
questions.explanation: In case expresses a precaution.

questions.prompt: Neither the manager nor the analysts _____ available this afternoon.
questions.explanation: The nearer subject analysts is plural.

questions.prompt: The proposal, along with its attachments, _____ ready for circulation.
questions.explanation: The main subject proposal is singular.

questions.prompt: A number of suppliers _____ submitted revised quotations.
questions.explanation: A number of + plural noun takes a plural verb.

questions.prompt: The number of unresolved issues _____ decreased since Monday.
questions.explanation: The number of + plural noun takes a singular verb.

questions.prompt: The vendor agreed to _____ the administrative fee.
questions.explanation: agree to + base verb.

questions.prompt: The proposed solution is technically _____ with the existing system.
questions.explanation: An adjective is needed after is.

questions.prompt: The quotation remains valid _____ Friday.
questions.explanation: Through means up to and including Friday.

questions.prompt: Customers affected by the outage are eligible _____ a service credit.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is eligible for.

options.B: The cafeteria will close early on Fridays.
options.D: Travel requests use a different form.

questions.prompt: Blank [2]
questions.explanation: The sentence contrasts already-approved contracts with later amendments that must follow the new process.

questions.prompt: Blank [3]
questions.explanation: The final draft receives the action, so future passive voice is required.

questions.prompt: Blank [4]

options.A: This sequence will ensure that the final version has the required approvals before signature.
options.B: The old printer will be replaced next week.
options.C: Parking spaces are limited near the office.
options.D: The vendor meeting starts at noon.

questions.explanation: This sequence clearly refers back to Finance approval, Legal approval, and forwarding to the signer.

questions.prompt: Not until the final quotation arrived _____ Procurement approve the order.
questions.explanation: Not until triggers inversion with did + subject + base verb.

questions.prompt: The committee recommended that the agreement _____ amended before signing.
questions.explanation: recommend that + subject + base verb; passive form is be amended.

questions.prompt: The vendor lowered the price. _____, the delivery date remained unchanged.
questions.explanation: The second statement contrasts with the first.

questions.prompt: The invoices _____ yesterday have already been reconciled.
questions.explanation: The invoices were received, so use the past participle.
